race.comment: LOVE AND PAIN (7) is unlucky to still be a maiden finishing runner-up in both runs this campaign and this is not an overly strong affair. Strips fitter third-up and Lerena stays on top following that last-start placing. Sure to play a pivotal role in the outcome. IGOTMYMINDONYOU (2) has gotten better with each run this time in work and looks to be building up to a maiden victory. Include with the claim. BRAZEN DIVA (3) is having her first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what she faced in the southern states. Respect any market confidence. EXCESS CAPITAL (5) has placed two of four over this sprint journey and looks one for the exotics players. KRASAKI (6) next best in a race with only a handful of chances.
